title: Diana Pasulka on the rituals rocket teams perform before launch

tellings.quote: listen to Diana Pulkin, she talks about this a lot about the ritualistic sort of performative uh rituals that they do prior to launching

plain: Rocket teams in the United States are said to perform ritual-like ceremonies before a launch. The YouTuber Chris Ramsay brings this up with Michels, pointing listeners to the religion scholar Diana Pasulka, who he says talks about it a lot. It would suggest a near-religious side to space work.
